findings.title: Drain the callback queued by ResizeObserver
findings.independent_triage: CONFIRMED_EARLY_RENDERER_READINESS: same-renderer continuation failed 3/3; exact published two-command helper stayed green 3/3. Removing the final task from the actual corrected function failed 3/3; corrected actual function passed 3/3.
findings.local_correction: MessageChannel task after the second rAF drains later callbacks in the same rendering update; both ports close before resolving. Permanent regression calls the actual self-contained browser function.

findings.title: Preserve transitions before validating the helper
findings.independent_triage: CONFIRMED_SOURCE_ORDER: detail-before screenshot with animations disabled precedes helper after addStyleTag
findings.local_correction: Readiness precedes the optional unscrolled capture; screenshot animations are allowed and never fast-forwarded. A real 300ms transition must end naturally before capture and the single scroll.

scope: External Codex code review of the second R3 candidate; runtime receipt is recorded separately.
resolution_scope: Local fixes and causal counterproofs prepared for a later commit. The published reviewed SHA remains completed_with_findings; only a new exact-SHA review can close external review status.
